<Heading
  as={"h1"}
  className={"openapi__heading"}
  children={"Set an aisle's travel centreline"}
>
</Heading>

<MethodEndpoint
  method={"put"}
  path={"/zones/{zoneId}/aisles/{aisleCode}/geometry"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Records an aisle's straight-line travel centreline (ADR-0017), used by the travel graph as this aisle's walkable path. The aisle must already exist and must not be Decommissioned. Publishes AisleGeometryUpdated.

  id={"request"}
  as={"h2"}
  className={"openapi-tabs__heading"}
>

</Heading>

>
  
</ParamsDetails>
